analysis.title: DoorDash Inc. (DASH) Q3'26 Earnings Review
key_insights: DoorDash reported Q3'26 Marketplace GOV of $33,941mm, 1% above both GS ($33,489mm) and consensus ($33,540mm) and above the $33.0-34.0bn guidance range. Management said consumer demand was healthy and it is constructive heading into 2027.

Q3'26 revenue was $4,616mm vs GS $4,513mm and consensus $4,560mm. Adj. EBITDA was $1,060mm vs GS $1,045mm and consensus $1,031mm, within the $950-1,100mm guidance range. Diluted GAAP EPS was $1.06 vs GS $0.81 and consensus $0.82.
Grocery and Retail is a key growth vector, with YoY growth rates more than 2x US restaurant growth. Broader selection and better affordability drove double-digit YoY growth across mature cohorts.

International momentum is accelerating across GOV and total orders. Management attributed it to product investments and operational learnings shared across geographies, and said profitability contributions came in ahead of internal expectations.

DoorDash announced a business combination agreement to acquire Instacart (CART) at $65.00 per share, an equity value of ~$17bn. It is subject to shareholder and regulatory approval and is expected to close at the end of 2027 or in 1H 2028.
Instacart holders can elect $65 cash, 0.3372 DASH shares, or a mix of $48.75 cash plus 0.843 DASH shares. Stock consideration is capped at 25% of the aggregate, so the deal is more than 75% cash.

Stated deal aims: improve online grocery (DASH cites 99%+ fulfillment accuracy and orders delivered more than 10 minutes faster on average), scale advertising with Instacart's CPG advertiser base, cross-sell DashPass and Instacart+ memberships through a unified subscription at the current DashPass price, and capture synergies.
Management framed a path to more than $500mm of annual synergies over time, but expects to reinvest more than 100% of synergies in the first year after close before net benefits turn positive.

Management framed a consumer AI view centered on building the leading physical network for retailers. 3P AI agents have generated only several hundred orders so far, but GS expects debate on agentic commerce implications for DASH, including advertising revenue and profitability, to continue.
Management expects FY26 free cash flow to be reduced by $700-800mm from the timing of merchant payments.

GS raised estimates: Q4'26 Marketplace GOV $35.80bn (from $35.57bn), revenue $4.77bn (from $4.74bn), Adj. EBITDA $1.07bn (from $1.02bn). For 2027, GOV $160.16bn (from $159.54bn), revenue $21.66bn (from $21.52bn), Adj. EBITDA $4.93bn (from $4.85bn).

GS is Not Rated on DASH because it is advising on the Instacart transaction. It has no price target and takes no view on the acquisition's likelihood or timing, and its estimates exclude any pro-forma assumptions.

GS sees delivery and local commerce as a secular theme in early innings, with online penetration well below overall eCommerce, and expects fulfillment, inventory digitization and promotional investment to accelerate consumer adoption.
DASH shares were $169.49 at the 28 Oct 2026 close, down 13.3% over 3 months, 1.4% over 6 months and 35.2% over 12 months. GS shows P/E of 61.2x on 2026E and 35.1x on 2027E.

DoorDash agreed to acquire Instacart at $65.00 per share, about $17bn of equity value. It is more than 75% cash, subject to approvals, and expected to close at the end of 2027 or 1H 2028.

Q3'26 (reported 10/29): revenue $4,616mm vs GS est $4,513mm and consensus $4,560mm. Orders were 993mm vs GS est 978mm and consensus 983mm, and AOV was $34.18.
Q3'26 (reported 10/29): Adj. EBITDA $1,060mm vs GS est $1,045mm and consensus $1,031mm, guidance $950-1,100mm. Adj. EBITDA margin was 23.0% of revenue and 3.1% of GOV.
Q3'26 (reported 10/29): diluted GAAP EPS $1.06 vs GS est $0.81 and consensus $0.82. Take rate was 13.6%.
New GS Q4'26 estimates: GOV $35.80bn, revenue $4.77bn, Adj. EBITDA $1.07bn, diluted GAAP EPS $0.85 (from $0.75), non-GAAP EPS $1.67 (from $1.55).
New GS 2027 estimates: GOV $160.16bn, revenue $21.66bn, Adj. EBITDA $4.93bn, diluted GAAP EPS $4.84 (from $4.61), non-GAAP EPS $7.99 (from $7.90).
New GS 2026E diluted EPS is $2.77 (from $2.43), 2028E is $7.20 (from $6.97), and 2028E revenue is $25,614mm.
Management said FY26 free cash flow will be hurt by $700-800mm from the timing of merchant payments.
